entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank Treasury's RAMP global network page lists the Bank of Guatemala as a RAMP member institution; RAMP's own description of the partnership covers advisory services, executive training and asset management for members, and the page does not say which of these Guatemala receives.
source_title: Global Network - Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership (World Bank Treasury)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago
detail: The World Bank Treasury's RAMP global network page lists the Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago as a RAMP member institution; the page does not state whether the relationship is advice, training or management of assets, only that RAMP offers all three to members.
source_title: Global Network - Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership (World Bank Treasury)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank Treasury's RAMP global network page lists the National Bank of Cambodia as a RAMP member institution; the page does not state whether the relationship is advice, training or management of assets.
source_title: Global Network - Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership (World Bank Treasury)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank Treasury's RAMP global network page lists the Bulgarian National Bank as a RAMP member institution and as a co-host of a RAMP forum; the page does not state whether the relationship is advice, training or management of assets.
source_title: Global Network - Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership (World Bank Treasury)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank Group states that the Central Bank of Ecuador joined RAMP, giving it access to World Bank Group advisory services, executive training and asset management expertise; the release describes advice, training and expertise rather than a mandate to manage Ecuador's reserves.
source_title: World Bank Group RAMP welcomes Central Bank of Ecuador as new member (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank states the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe joined RAMP through a multi-donor trust fund and signed a technical assistance agreement; the release describes technical assistance to strengthen the bank's public asset management capability, not management of its reserves.
source_title: World Bank RAMP announces new member Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina (CBBH)
detail: The World Bank states the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina signed a legal agreement joining RAMP, which provides members with advisory services, training and asset management services; the release does not say which of these the CBBH takes.
source_title: Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina joins World Bank RAMP to enhance reserve management (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: Central Bank of the Republic of Armenia (CBA)
detail: The World Bank states the Central Bank of Armenia rejoined RAMP for advisory services and training resources, with RAMP providing onsite expertise to improve its reserve management operations and training for new staff; it was a member from 2006 to 2014. This is advice and training, not management of assets.
source_title: Central Bank of the Republic of Armenia rejoins World Bank Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank states the Central Bank of Paraguay joined RAMP in 2017 and that RAMP provided advisory services and executive training that helped the bank rebuild its own investment policy and diversify reserves away from bank deposits; the bank runs the portfolio itself, so this is advice and training rather than management of assets.
source_title: A partner in Paraguay: transforming reserve management at the Central Bank of Paraguay with World Bank RAMP (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (CBK)
detail: The Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo states it became a RAMP member under an agreement with the World Bank Treasury, described as designed to increase the institution's capacity and expertise in asset management, risk management and financial reporting; this is advice, training and capacity building, not management of its reserves.
as_of: announced at the IMF-World Bank annual meetings, Marrakesh (2023)
source_title: Governor Ismaili after CBK's membership in the World Bank Treasury's RAMP program (Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank states the Central Bank of Cabo Verde signed a technical assistance agreement delivering RAMP technical advisory services and became the 75th member of the RAMP network; the release describes advisory services, not management of assets.
source_title: World Bank RAMP trust fund to improve public asset management announces second beneficiary: Cabo Verde (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The World Bank states the Central Bank of Liberia joined RAMP and signed a technical assistance agreement to build its public asset management capacity; the release describes technical assistance and training, and does not say RAMP manages CBL assets.
source_title: Central Bank of Liberia joins World Bank RAMP, global partnership of public asset managers (World Bank)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP) program
detail: The Central Bank of Libya states it signed a cooperation agreement under the World Bank's RAMP framework at World Bank headquarters, aimed at better returns on its foreign currency reserves through international best practice in asset allocation, portfolio and risk management, plus human capital, accounting and legal development; the bank describes exchange of expertise and capacity building, not handing reserves to RAMP to manage.
source_title: Central Bank of Libya signs cooperation agreement under the RAMP program (Central Bank of Libya)

entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
name_as_stated: World Bank's Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
detail: The Central Bank of Seychelles reports that RAMP runs an externally managed portfolio of its international reserves, first funded with US$100 million in 2019 and still held at end-2025, and that RAMP also delivered workshops and executive forums and sponsored staff qualifications during 2025; this is actual management of assets alongside advice and training.
source_title: International Reserves Management Report 2025 (Central Bank of Seychelles)

entity: Crown Agents Investment Management
detail: The Central Bank of Seychelles reports that Crown Agents Investment Management runs an externally managed fixed income portfolio of its reserves, split 50-50 between US dollars and Chinese renminbi, with a mandate that began in 2014 at US$25.0 million and a further US$25.0 million added in April 2022; this is actual management of assets.
source_title: International Reserves Management Report 2025 (Central Bank of Seychelles)

entity: UBS Asset Management
detail: The Central Bank of Seychelles reports that UBS manages a money market fund holding part of its reserves, initially funded with US$10.0 million in 2017 and still held at end-2025, and that UBS also invited bank staff to its annual reserves management seminar; this is management of assets plus training.
source_title: International Reserves Management Report 2025 (Central Bank of Seychelles)

entity: BNP Paribas Asset Management
detail: Chile's Ministry of Finance states BNP Paribas Asset Management is the sole external manager of the US agency mortgage-backed securities portfolio of Chile's sovereign wealth funds, and that the Banco Central de Chile runs the selection of external managers, manages the sovereign fixed income share of the funds itself, and supervises external managers investing in instruments eligible for the international reserves; this is management of assets.
as_of: page current as of 2026 (notes Western Asset Management's exit in September 2024)
source_title: Quien administra los fondos actualmente? - Fondos Soberanos (Ministerio de Hacienda, Chile)

entity: BlackRock
detail: Chile's Ministry of Finance states BlackRock Institutional Trust Company manages the high yield bond and corporate bond portfolios of Chile's sovereign wealth funds, for which the Banco Central de Chile runs the external manager selection process and supervises managers investing in instruments eligible for the international reserves; this is management of assets.
as_of: page current as of 2026 (notes Western Asset Management's exit in September 2024)
source_title: Quien administra los fondos actualmente? - Fondos Soberanos (Ministerio de Hacienda, Chile)
